questions.context_sentence: For more information, you can write to Juanita Halter at juanita@centralfloridamediagroup.com or call at 8633-248-7537.

questions.context_sentence: Music is all around.
questions.cn: 四周都是音乐。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：a + round（圆的）-> 围绕成一个圈，即“在周围”。

questions.meaning: adj. 令人激动的;使人兴奋的
questions.context_sentence: How exciting!
questions.cn: 多么令人兴奋啊！
questions.hint: 联想记忆：excite（使兴奋）+ ing -> 令人激动的（修饰物/事）。
options: 令人激动的;使人兴奋的

questions.context_sentence: People play it outside and it's interesting.
questions.cn: 人们在外面玩它，这很有趣。
questions.hint: 合成词记忆：out（外面）+ side（边）-> 在外面。
questions.prompt: People play it ____ and it's interesting. (提示: 在外面)

questions.context_sentence: In many southern provinces, there are some breakfast foods made from rice.
questions.cn: 在许多南方省份，有一些由大米制成的早餐食物。
questions.hint: 短语记忆：be made from 表示“由……制成（看不出原材料，发生化学变化）”。

questions.meaning: 数以千计的;许许多多的
questions.context_sentence: As we know, Southern China has grown rice for thousands of years.
questions.cn: 众所周知，中国南方种植大米已有数千年的历史。
questions.hint: 短语记忆：thousands of + 复数名词，表示“成千上万的，数以千计的”。
options: 数以千计的;许许多多的

questions.context_sentence: Different people like different tastes.
questions.cn: 不同的人喜欢不同的口味。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：tas（看作 task 任务）+ te -> 品尝美味是一项快乐的任务。
questions.prompt: Different people like different ____. (提示: 味道;滋味)

questions.context_sentence: They especially love spicy(辣的) rice noodles.
questions.cn: 他们特别喜欢辣米粉。
questions.hint: 联想记忆：es + pecially（看作 special 特别的）-> 尤其，特别。

questions.context_sentence: Even though he only has one arm, he's really good at it.
